internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchAnnotate	unversioned: marker: post-commit bench run record, annotated with the compared commit and baseline
internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchComplete	unversioned: marker: post-commit bench run record closed with end time and exit status
internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchFinish	unversioned: marker: post-commit bench run record marked done or failed before its notice
internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchLock	unversioned: marker: uid-scoped machine-wide benchmark measurement lock
internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchReconcile	unversioned: marker: abandoned post-commit benchmarks requeued for detached recovery
internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchRecover	unversioned: marker: config-local benchmark consumer lock
internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchSnapshot	unversioned: marker: benchstat wrapper and immutable compared baselines, pruned after 7 days
internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchStart	unversioned: marker: atomically published post-commit benchmark job, pruned after 7 days
internal/hooks/docs/benchrun.go:benchWorker	unversioned: marker: post-commit benchmark running and completed lifecycle, pruned after 7 days
internal/hooks/docs/plan.go:claimPlanFile	unversioned: marker: reserved dated plan file, replaced by the plan
internal/hooks/docs/plan.go:dropRecord	unversioned: marker: plan mirror record emptied when it cannot be removed
